## Decision

- Needs reviewer attention before upstream: findings remain.

## Confirmed findings

- Siblings not enumerated exhaustively: cli_smoke module inclusion order (mixed_quote_rename placed before native_fanout) and any future sibling test module following the same shape should follow the same lang-rust gate pattern; this is calibration guidance, not a defect.

## Refuted

- split_once(" \"b/") could mis-split an unquoted old path containing literal space-quote-b inside it.; refuted because: Git would have whole-path C-quoted any path containing "; an unquoted old path cannot legitimately contain "; the new boundary is unambiguous and the unquoted split_once(" b/") fallback is retained for the unquoted-both case.
- A symmetric independently-quoted SOURCE boundary (vs the fixed DESTINATION boundary) creates a parallel blind spot in parse_new_path_marker or hunk readers.; refuted because: parse_new_path_marker and parse_diff_path_token operate on a single token and never split on ` b/`; hunk headers route through the same per-token decoder, so no analogous unquoted/quoted boundary exists to miss.

## Parked follow-ups

- Park for follow-up (not this PR): verify no other diff consumer assumes symmetric `a/... b/...` quoting outside path.rs; the inheritance list in the changelog fragment is currently scoped to metadata/disclosure/native decoder/confinement/loader pin only.

## Evidence gaps

- Model proof intent was rejected by deterministic validation.
